name: Captcha solver
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Solve captchas locally in qutebrowser — tesseract OCR for image captchas and a local speech-to-text backend for the reCAPTCHA audio challenge. No API keys, nothing leaves the machine.

features: Local image-captcha solving with tesseract (omarchy-captcha-solve), no network or API key
Local reCAPTCHA audio-challenge transcription (omarchy-captcha-transcribe) via whisper.cpp, vosk or a local endpoint
qute-captcha userscript: find a captcha on the page, fill the field, show the guess for confirmation
Never auto-submits - the guess is always shown for a human to check

bindings.description: Solve the captcha on the current page (local OCR)
Transcribe a downloaded captcha audio challenge
Report which local captcha tools are available
